request_text: Load the IEEE 14-bus system and set the active load at bus 14 to 15.2 MW.
answer:

PQ load buses are 4, 5, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, and buses 2, 3, 6 also have local load together with generation. The requested modification is at bus 14, changing active load from 15.959706 MW to 15.2 MW while reactive load at bus 14 remains 5.355606 Mvar.

Branches are all in-service lines and transformers. Line ids 0 to 14 correspond to the net.line row indices for branches 1-2, 1-5, 2-3, 2-4, 2-5, 3-4, 4-5, 6-11, 6-12, 6-13, 9-10, 9-14, 10-11, 12-13, 13-14. Transformer ids are 100000 to 100004 corresponding to rows 0 to 4 of net.trafo for branches 4-7, 4-9, 5-6, 7-8, 7-9.

Requested quantities are bus voltage magnitudes in p.u. and angles in degrees, branch active power at the from side in MW, branch loading in percent, and total generation, load, and losses in MW. Since ratings are undefined, loading_percent is reported as 0 for all branches.

Compared with the given base case, only active load at bus 14 changes downward by 0.759706 MW. Therefore total load decreases by that amount, and in the solved AC power flow the slack generation adjusts accordingly while PV voltage setpoints remain enforced unless reactive limits bind. Power balance must satisfy total generation equals total load plus total active losses.
